name: The Truth About Serum
description:
Genetics has its own little glassware for carrying chosen genes over to Larvae. The Serum Vial will let you carry one gene to a Larvae. That's kind of underwhelming, so it's better to combine a few of them into a Serum Array. Then you can have a full buffet and pick one of each possible trait.

You must "charge" the Serum in a Polymerizer. Then you can feed it into an Inoculator or a Splicer to modify a Larvae. Look at the number of charges left on the Serum to see how many times you can do this. You can recharge it by putting it back in a Polymerizer. So if you ever get a magic recipe, you can just leave a Serum Array of it around and just recharge it as you need it.

[note]You cannot recharge Serums using a Thaumic Restorer.[/note]
